name: ALTMAR-PARISH-WILLIAMSTOWN CENTRAL SCHOOL DISTRICT
notes: FEDERAL FILING ANOMALY, not an unread policy. This state prohibits corporal punishment in public schools by statute (see data/states), yet the district's 2023-24 CRDC filing reports students receiving it. The project's analysis of these filings (facts/claims/crdc-ban-state-reports-2023-24.md) finds the pattern consistent with restraint or seclusion miscoded as corporal punishment. Closed 2026-09-24; reopen if the district or OCR corrects the filing.
